description: Three-wave competitor/adjacent-platform research backlog. See competitor-research-corpus-plan.md §6. `url` is null where no verified URL was available (fill manually before crawling — do not guess). `pricing_model`: free | freemium | subscription | hardware | quote | unknown.

waves.1: Core baseball apps — cleanest signal (target 1,500-2,500 items)
waves.2: Data, hardware, and player-profile systems (target 1,000-1,500 items)

platforms.name: GameChanger
platforms.why: Dominant youth workflow: scoring, streaming, stats, athlete profiles, now AI lineup recommendations on sabermetric principles.

platforms.name: iScore Baseball/Softball
platforms.why: Deep scorebook: spray/pitch charts, 500+ stats, no extra fee to access stats; strong traditional-scoring competitor.

platforms.name: TeamSnap
platforms.why: Admin-first incumbent: schedule, chat, availability, parent UX, league adoption; acquired MOJO.

platforms.name: Stack the Lineup
platforms.why: Pure fair-play lineup tool: equal playing time, infield/outfield balance, bench warnings, PDF export.

platforms.name: Rizzler Baseball
platforms.why: All-in-one coaching: lineups, fielding, AI optimization, real-time pitch counting w/ rest days, tournament planning, scoring, evaluations, rule compliance.

platforms.name: Baseball Fielding Rotation App / FreeBaseballLineups
platforms.why: Free fair-fielding-rotation generator up to 7 innings; baseline for low-friction utility expectations.

platforms.name: Lineup Card
platforms.why: Legacy lineup + defensive-position tracker; rotations by inning; share rosters/lineups. Useful legacy-UX study.

platforms.name: MOJO Sports
platforms.why: Youth-coach content: practice plans, videos, scheduling, attendance, messaging; TeamSnap-owned.

platforms.name: USA Baseball Mobile Coach / USAB Develops
platforms.why: Standards-based free baseline: 300+ drills, practice plans, Skills Matrix, Pitch Smart, badges/challenges, parent resources.

platforms.name: Dominate the Diamond
platforms.why: Youth-specific practice plans, drill bundles, app content; reviews praise plans and video links.

platforms.name: Driveline / TRAQ
platforms.why: Data-driven dev platform: schedule workouts, program athletes, review video; integrates Rapsodo/Blast/TrackMan/Pocket Radar/DK/PitchLogic; 3,000+ facilities.

platforms.name: Mustard Pitching
platforms.why: Phone-first pitching mechanics: video submission -> report card -> personalized plan; Tom House framework.

platforms.name: Trosky 365
platforms.why: Daily development + mindset + infield; 1,000+ lessons; language around habits, routines, complete-player growth.

platforms.name: CoachNow
platforms.why: Remote coaching / video communication; coach-athlete feedback loops (not baseball-specific curriculum).

platforms.name: OnForm
platforms.why: Strong video analysis: capture, HD slow-mo, sharing, coach feedback for baseball/softball.

platforms.name: GameTime Lineups
platforms.why: Focused fair lineup creation/rotation w/ native Android app; comparison baseline against broader Rizzler workflow.

platforms.name: Coach Joel's Way / Baseball & Softball Lineup App
platforms.why: Positions explicitly around game-day lineups, playing time, and organization.

platforms.name: AthletesGoLive
platforms.why: Streaming/scoring competitor with mixed/negative sentiment on UX, roster linking, reliability — good failure-mode signal.

platforms.name: Ballplayer
platforms.why: Social scorekeeping designed for 'stats that follow the player' from little league onward.

platforms.name: Baseball Blueprint
platforms.why: Drill/practice-plan/playbook competitor; study drill taxonomy, practice-builder UX, field diagrams, clipboard workflows.

platforms.name: Pocket Radar / Smart Coach
platforms.why: Affordable velo capture; performance app requires Smart Coach hardware; GameChanger pitch-velo integration. Low-friction measurable entry point.

platforms.name: Rapsodo Baseball / PRO 2.0
platforms.why: High-value hitting+pitching data + video; team practice on one device; facility/elite tier.

platforms.name: HitTrax
platforms.why: Cage simulation + data system: games/leagues, real-time data, video analysis. No public API — CSV/session export only.

platforms.name: Blast Motion / Blast Baseball
platforms.why: Bat sensor + swing analyzer with video capture and swing metrics; swing-data taxonomy reference.

platforms.name: Diamond Kinetics
platforms.why: Bat sensor + app: real-time swing metrics, swing score, guided lessons, games, MLB content. Closest to kid-engagement.

platforms.name: TrackMan (via PBR / showcases)
platforms.why: Advanced/expensive ball-tracking benchmark used in showcase/facility settings; PBR tech partner for event data.

platforms.name: Perfect Game / DiamondKast / PG Profile
platforms.why: Showcase/tournament profile ecosystem: DiamondKast live stats feed PG Profile; DiamondKast Plus adds highlight clips to the resume.

platforms.name: Prep Baseball / PBR
platforms.why: Scouting ecosystem: free player profiles updated with verified stats and videos during events; rankings, event data.

platforms.name: FieldLevel
platforms.why: Recruiting network: athlete profiles, resources, coach/team discovery.

platforms.name: SportsRecruits
platforms.why: Recruiting platform: athlete profiles, college search, roster needs, coach connections.

platforms.name: NCSA
platforms.why: Large recruiting-service: education, profiles, recruiting guidance, coach search. Polarized sentiment — read carefully.

platforms.name: CURVE Sports / Diamond Allegiance / CURVE Test
platforms.why: Unified youth-baseball platform connecting clubs, objective testing, dev standards, recruiting, ops; Ball/Body/Brain. Closest direct concept competitor.

platforms.name: Pitch 2 Pitch / CURVE Test
platforms.why: Expands measurables beyond ball flight into athlete movement and game processing (Ball/Body/Brain).

platforms.name: SportsEngine
platforms.why: Major youth-sports platform: scheduling, team management, communication, league operations.

platforms.name: LeagueApps
platforms.why: Club/league/facility operating platform: registration, waivers, payments, schedules, facilities, reporting, comms, mobile.

platforms.name: Spond
platforms.why: Free team management: planning, invites, group setup, payments, club management. Source for 'parents hate admin chaos'.

platforms.name: TeamLinkt
platforms.why: Free team management: scheduling, messaging, attendance, team pages, budgets. Compares 'free team ops' expectations.

platforms.name: SportsEngine Tourney / Tourney Machine
platforms.why: Tournament workflow benchmark: schedules, brackets, field grids, standings, mobile access.

additional_research_targets: League registration/payment tools (SportsEngine HQ, LeagueApps, Stack Sports) — willingness-to-pay + org-layer ownership
Local league websites and coach-resource pages — grassroots workflow expectations
Tournament rule PDFs and schedule pages — multi-game planning + compliance constraints
